result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is one filter in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, plus a sentence in its Javadoc. The filter is `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same condition the per-quarter and latest purchase-order queries use.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, `CountryPurchaseOrdersTest` and `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest` pass offline. I didn't add a test that covers a cancelled order, so the existing tests don't show the fix for this case. Nothing is committed.

The per-country purchase-order count (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`, just below) has the same gap: it also counts cancelled orders. I left it alone because the task only covers the per-rep report. It's a one-line change if you want it too.
